confidence_notes: Food and coffee estimates use a [July 2026 Numbeo snapshot](https://northremovals.com.au/cost-of-living-melbourne-vs-sydney/); beer represents a 0.5-litre draft serving. Cocktail and wine estimates use [local drinks guidance](https://bestinmelbourne.co/how-much-do-bars-cost-in-melbourne-2026-guide/), with wine estimated slightly above beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and less certain, especially across dates and locations.
comparable_city_reasoning: Melbourne dining data provides the primary basis; accommodation estimates also reflect the broader market for major Australian cities and July travel demand.
